body: Thanks for the ack. Ownership update: the aida-host product seat, not claude/fix-29b, now owns the 29b6c9b fix-forward. Keep holding all aida-host wrapper changes. Priority for this seat: the #2676 (BUG-2148) round-2 rework. Read it with aida review verdict BUG-2148: three blocking items (agent stop must not reap a live, unconfirmed agent; the SIGKILL re-check and the session_end path need injected-matcher tests; the TOML path at tests :106/:139 breaks the portability ratchet). Locally, interrupt tests fail spuriously because of the live wrapper SIGINT bug; ignore those and rely on CI. Mail REWORK READY with the new head.
subject: Update: the product seat owns the 29b6c9b fixes; continue BUG-2148 #2676 rework
